code: library(vtamR) library(dplyr)  read_count_file <- system.file("extdata/demo/8_filter_replicate.csv", package = "vtamR") taxonomy <- system.file("extdata/db_test/taxonomy_reduced.tsv", package = "vtamR") sampleinfo <- system.file("extdata/demo/sampleinfo_mfzr_plate1.csv", package = "vtamR") blast_db <- system.file("extdata/db_test", package = "vtamR") blast_db <- file.path(blast_db, "COInr_reduced") outdir_mock <- "mock_composition2" options(vtamR.log_file =  file.path(outdir_mock, "vtamR_log.csv")) read_count_df <- read.csv(read_count_file) sampleinfo_df <- read.csv(sampleinfo)  # select mock samples in sampleinfo mock_samples <- sampleinfo_df %>%   filter(sample_type == "mock")  # select mock samples from read_count_df read_count_mock <- read_count_df %>%   filter(sample %in% mock_samples$sample)

title: Tutorial - vtamR pipeline
text: vtamR advanced, R-based revision VTAM (Validation Taxonomic Assignment Metabarcoding Data). provides comprehensive metabarcoding pipeline, enabling: End--End Sequence Analysis: Processes raw FASTQ files amplicon sequences generate validated Amplicon Sequence Variant (ASV) table, ASVs assigned taxonomic groups. Replicate Handling: Supports technical biological replicates sample. Control-Based Filtering: Uses positive negative control samples refine filtering, minimizing false positives false negatives. Novelties Compared VTAM Modular Design: series R functions, vtamR highly adaptable, allowing users include, exclude, reorder analysis steps needed. Flexible Preprocessing: Demultiplexing subsampling FASTA FASTQ pairs. Denoising SWARM: Incorporates SWARM robust denoising amplicon sequence variants (ASVs). Post-Processing Swarms: Splits swarms among abundant ASVs prevent pooling highly similar yet distinct ASVs, preserving intra-specific variability. Visualization Tools: Offers graphic options aid data interpretation decision-making. Filtering Statistics: Includes functions generate statistics filtering step (e.g., read variant counts). Uses VSEARCH SWARM cluster ASVs molecular operational taxonomic units (mOTUs). Provides visualization tools help users select optimal clustering parameters. Simplified Workflow: concepts “marker” “run” removed streamline analyses. Detailed Log File: Records major functions called, along parameters runtimes. Summary Information: Facilitates publication results (e.g., MIEM checklist). Flexible Output: Formats output direct use phyloseq vegan. Overview vtamR Workflow

what: Validation and Taxonomic Assigment of Metabarcoding data with R
title: Validation and Taxonomic Assigment of Metabarcoding data with R
text: vtamR advanced, R-based revision VTAM (Validation Taxonomic Assignment Metabarcoding Data). provides comprehensive metabarcoding pipeline, enabling: End--End Sequence Analysis: Processes raw FASTQ files amplicon sequences generate validated Amplicon Sequence Variant (ASV) table, ASVs assigned taxonomic groups. Replicate Handling: Supports technical biological replicates sample. Control-Based Filtering: Uses positive negative control samples refine filtering, minimizing false positives false negatives. Novelties Compared VTAM Modular Design: series R functions, vtamR highly adaptable, allowing users include, exclude, reorder analysis steps needed. Flexible Preprocessing: Demultiplexing subsampling FASTA FASTQ pairs. Denoising SWARM: Incorporates SWARM robust denoising amplicon sequence variants (ASVs). Post-Processing Swarms: Splits swarms among abundant ASVs prevent pooling highly similar yet distinct ASVs, preserving intra-specific variability. Visualization Tools: Offers graphic options aid data interpretation decision-making. Filtering Statistics: Includes functions generate statistics filtering step (e.g., read variant counts). Uses VSEARCH SWARM cluster ASVs molecular operational taxonomic units (mOTUs). Provides visualization tools help users select optimal clustering parameters. Simplified Workflow: concepts “marker” “run” removed streamline analyses. Detailed Log File: Records major functions called, along parameters runtimes. Summary Information: Facilitates publication results (e.g., MIEM checklist). Flexible Output: Formats output direct use phyloseq vegan.

what: Assign taxonomy using BLAST-based Lowest Common Ancestor (LTG) method — assign_taxonomy_ltg
title: Assign taxonomy using BLAST-based Lowest Common Ancestor (LTG) method — assign_taxonomy_ltg
text: Assign Lowest Taxonomic Group (LTG) ASV using BLAST-based Lowest Common Ancestor approach. function implements mkLTG algorithm described Meglécz (2024) https://rdcu./dxABF https://github.com/meglecz/mkLTG. evaluates BLAST hits across multiple identity thresholds, associated specific filtering parameters. identity threshold (pid), following parameters used: pcov: percentage query coverage phit: proportion validated hits required LTG assignment taxn: minimum number taxa among validated hits seqn: minimum number sequences among validated hits refres: minimum resolution validated hits ltgres: maximum resolution resulting LTG
